title: Synthetic Symbiosis
teaser: Engineering bacterial-fungal consortia for division of labor.
description: We engineer bacterial-fungal consortia for division of labor in lignocellulose bioconversion. By establishing metabolic cross-feeding, we create stable, robust communities capable of processing complex substrates.

title: Myco-Materials
teaser: Programming fungal hyphae for living composites.
description: Programming fungal hyphae to express variable chitin content, creating functional living composites for construction and sensing. These materials are self-healing and adaptive.

title: Metabolic Sovereignty
teaser: Decentralized energy generation using microbial cells.
description: Decentralized energy generation using Photo-Microbial Fuel Cells and non-model fungal hosts optimized via genome-scale modeling. We aim for autonomous bio-energy systems.

title: Planetary Remediation
description: Deploying engineered myco-remediators to sequester heavy metals and degrade microplastics in soil systems. This is active ecological repair.
